topics.title: Formation & Stem Rules of the Imperfect Tense (l'Imparfait)
topics.objective: Master the morphological formation of l'imparfait by deriving stems from the 1st person plural (*nous*) present tense form and applying the standard endings (-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient).

topics.title: Aspectual Uses of the Imparfait: Habitual Actions, Descriptions, & Background States
topics.objective: Apply l'imparfait appropriately to convey uncompleted past actions, habitual/iterative past routines, physical and emotional descriptions, weather conditions, time, and background contexts.

topics.title: Passé Composé vs Imparfait Contrast & Interrupted Actions
topics.objective: Contrast completed specific events (Passé Composé) with background continuous states or ongoing actions (Imparfait) within single and compound complex sentences.

topics.title: Past Temporal Expressions & Duration Markers (Depuis, Pendant, Il y a, En)
topics.objective: Distinguish and correctly deploy past time prepositions (*depuis*, *pendant*, *il y a*, *en*, *dans*) to anchor past actions, duration, and elapsed time relative to the moment of speech.
